tools.name: brain_query
tools.description: Search and recall memories using hybrid FTS + vector + spreading activation. Returns ranked nodes with retrievability and salience scores.

agent.description: Your own agent id (this is a multi-agent brain server).

tools.name: brain_write
tools.description: Store a new memory node. Automatically queues for embedding and PRISM/NEXUS auto-linking.

agent.description: Your own agent id (this is a multi-agent brain server).

tools.name: brain_link
tools.description: Create a typed edge between two existing nodes.

agent.description: Your own agent id (this is a multi-agent brain server).

tools.name: brain_supersede
tools.description: Replace an outdated node with updated content. Closes old edges, writes a supersedes edge, preserving the memory graph's temporal integrity.

agent.description: Your own agent id (this is a multi-agent brain server).

old_node_id.description: ID of the node being superseded

new_content.description: Updated content for the replacement node

tools.name: brain_stats
tools.description: Return brain statistics: node/edge/episode counts, neuromodulator state, consolidation status, embedding coverage. Supports format=prometheus for Prometheus metrics.

agent.description: Your own agent id (this is a multi-agent brain server).

tools.name: brain_history
tools.description: Search episode history (raw conversation turns) by keyword.

agent.description: Your own agent id (this is a multi-agent brain server).

since.description: Unix ms timestamp — only return episodes after this

until.description: Unix ms timestamp — only return episodes before this

tools.name: brain_expand
tools.description: Get full detail for a specific node: content, FSRS metrics, encoding context, and source episodes.

agent.description: Your own agent id (this is a multi-agent brain server).

tools.name: brain_review
tools.description: Apply an FSRS-6 spaced-repetition review to a node. Updates stability, retrievability, and SIGMA calibration.

agent.description: Your own agent id (this is a multi-agent brain server).

node_id.description: ID of the node to review

tools.name: brain_forget
tools.description: Physically delete a node from the brain. Refuses to delete nodes with active edges unless force=true.

agent.description: Your own agent id (this is a multi-agent brain server).

node_id.description: ID of the node to delete

force.description: If true, also drops active edges (default false)

tools.name: brain_edges
tools.description: Get all active incoming and outgoing edges for a node.

agent.description: Your own agent id (this is a multi-agent brain server).

tools.name: brain_reset
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE. Wipe this agent's entire brain — every node, edge, episode, vector, working-memory row, and the self-model — and re-seed an empty self-model. A timestamped .db backup is taken first. Embedding config (Ollama/OpenRouter) and the vec table's dimension are untouched. Requires confirm to exactly equal this agent's id.

agent.description: Your own agent id (this is a multi-agent brain server).

confirm.description: Must exactly equal this agent's id for the reset to proceed.
